item.description: YourKeep is an open-source backup tool that encrypts files locally, splits them into shards kept across different cloud drives or disks, and needs only a subset to restore the originals — for example, any 2 of 3 shards. It requires no account and no upload to a server, with recovery free forever, and runs on iOS, Android, Windows, macOS and Linux. The developer is giving away iOS lifetime codes through Apple's official redemption link on V2EX.

item.title: [infoq] 从 App 到 Agent：字节跳动 Supabase 的 Agent-Native 规模化实践｜QCon上海
item.description: At QCon Shanghai, ByteDance senior engineer Zhang Guoqiang will present how ByteDance's Supabase evolved from an App backend into an Agent-Native one. For apps it relies on Serverless, Data as Git and automatic frontend deployment to accelerate app generation; for agents it adds an AI Gateway, Sandbox, memory store and knowledge base as a secure, governable runtime. The talk draws on Doubao app generation and TRAE coding practice to review the key trade-offs.

item.description: Amazon Web Services launched CloudWatch Omni, an AI-first observability platform that goes beyond standard metrics to capture end-to-end agent traces and assess correctness, coherence, retrieval quality and tool selection, letting teams build test datasets from production traffic and catch regressions. It supports frameworks including LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI SDK and Strands, is built on open standards such as OpenTelemetry, and ships both an SSO web console and a free VS Code/Kiro extension.

item.title: [infoq] Istio 1.31 拥抱 AI 智能体，却先宣布“告别”Google Cloud
item.description: Istio 1.31 lets teams run agentgateway, the Rust data plane Solo.io donated to the Linux Foundation, as a layer-7 waypoint proxy in ambient mesh via a new istio-agentgateway-waypoint GatewayClass that also handles protocols like MCP. The same release stops publishing container images and Helm charts to Google Cloud, so anyone still pulling from gcr.io/istio-release or registry.istio.io must migrate before the October 13 blackout test; those services retire in December.

item.title: [infoq] Atlassian 围绕 OpenTelemetry 构建了大规模的指标管道
item.description: Atlassian detailed migrating its metrics platform — roughly 100,000 hosts across 14 regions under a 99.95% SLO — from gostatsd to OpenTelemetry. Rather than force thousands of services onto new SDKs, the team kept the StatsD-over-UDP interface and rebuilt everything behind it, turning an org-wide migration into a platform-team effort. Replacing gostatsd sidecars with a Collector distribution and folding metrics into the tracing sidecar cut sidecar resource use across the fleet by about 30%.

item.title: [github_trending] NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
item.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering framework built and maintained by the National Security Agency's Research Directorate. It bundles disassembly, decompilation, graphing and scripting for Windows, macOS and Linux binaries across many processor instruction sets, and runs both interactively and in automated mode. Users can extend it with Java or Python, making it a customizable platform for malware analysis and large-team SRE work.
